title: Geoeconomic Monitor: Election Season
text:
Geoeconomic Monitor: Election Season

Tom Miller, Tom Holland, Will Denyer

Gavekal Research | 30 Oct 2026

This week’s elections dealt crushing blows to Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil and Aleksandar Vučić in Serbia. With next week’s US midterms looking ominous for the Republicans, voters appear to be turning against the populist right. The upcoming elections in Spain and France will show whether the tide really has turned, says Tom Miller. In Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu may yet cling to power. If Israel and the US restart their bombing campaign in Iran, global oil prices will surge to new highs, writes Tom Holland. And there is little Congress can do to stop it, even if the Democrats take the Senate in the midterms, argues Will Denyer.In this issue:
